tests.title: Edit this order keeps warehouse, shipping store, remark and product names
tests.goal: Editing an order changes only what the user changed.
preconditions: A pending QA order with warehouse Office and a customer remark

steps.text: Order detail > Actions > Edit this order > Use order creation date
Check the POS warehouse matches the order warehouse
Reduce one line by 1, Total > Bank Transfer > CHECK OUT > OK > Done
Open the replacement order (…A) in the CRM and in eShop My Orders

expected.text: Original order is Canceled and the replacement total is reduced by the line price
Warehouse and Shipping Store equal the original
Product names are unchanged (same language as the original)
Internal remark contains the original order number

checks.label: Original order is Canceled and the replacement total is reduced by the line price
Warehouse and Shipping Store equal the original
Product names are unchanged (same language as the original)
Internal remark contains the original order number

notes: TXN0126102700027 -> 027A: original Canceled, total 323.00 -> 161.50 (correct). Warehouse Office -> TaiPo (line now Pre-order Qty 1), Shipping Store dropped, customer remark twice, "test product CN 1" in CRM and eShop. Internal remark has the original number. 027A voided afterwards.
